answer: A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the timber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
